subject: Diamond's cold Kira evidence consumer, vendored into Genesis so one release can verify its own exported evidence

upstream.note: 0d3cc66 is Diamond's origin/main. It adds the small-order/non-canonical point refusals (diamond/ed25519.py, diamond/kira_evidence.py) and binds the receipt/entry/record content digest before the optional --store check. Eight of the nine files below were re-hashed against THIS commit; LICENSE is the one exception and is held at 74004738 — see `license`.

license: AGPL-3.0. LICENSE here is HELD at 7400473825c5af4c17657604bf3d9c3c749ff1a1 and is deliberately NOT the file 0d3cc66 carries: the later commit deletes the 17-line copyright and permission notice that opens the file, leaving the AGPL-3.0 body. Re-vendoring it would drop that notice, so the hold is recorded rather than silently followed or silently papered over. No licence text was written or edited by hand; the decision belongs to review.
layout: upstream paths are preserved VERBATIM below vendor/diamond-cold/ (diamond/ and scripts/), so the verifier resolves its own package exactly as it does upstream. It is invoked with an explicit --package-root naming this directory; nothing here relies on a sibling checkout.
provenance: git -C ~/aukora-diamond show <commit>:<path> > vendor/diamond-cold/<path>, one file at a time; no byte was edited after extraction. diamond/kira_evidence.py and diamond/ed25519.py were (re)copied this way at 0d3cc66; the other six pinned code files were copied this way at 74004738 and are byte-identical at both commits, so their bytes were left untouched. LICENSE is NOT byte-identical at both and was therefore left at 74004738.
scope: This is the COLD KIRA EVIDENCE CLOSURE ONLY. The legacy grant/demo/loader runtime is deliberately absent: the packet that scoped this increment says not to copy the whole Diamond repository merely because a distiller copies directories.

runtime.note: The entry point is Python, not Node. It is a SEPARATE PROCESS from the running app and is never on the request path.
